newsitem.title: SINGAPORE: Econ in US$255 mln Jakarta deal - paper.
newsitem.headline: Econ in US$255 mln Jakarta deal - paper.

text.p: Econ International Ltd, which was taken over last year by Indonesia's Yenville Pte Ltd, plans to invest at least US255 million to develop a mixed commercial project in Jakarta, the Straits Times said on Thursday.
Yenville is led by Indonesia's Pribadi family, it said.

It said the investment includes around $31.21 million spent by the company last year to acquire a 5.8 hectare site in Jakarta. Work will take place in stages to lessen the burden of financing the project, the newspaper said.

Phase one of the project, at a cost of about $60 million, including land cost, will begin in the third quarter of next year. It will consist of about 230 units of three and four-storey shophouses, and a retail shopping centre with gross floor area of 50,000 sq m.
Subsequent phases could include a 300-room hotel, 50,000 sq m of office space and 600 apartments, the newspaper said.
